tw.settingsModal.title: Settings
tw.settingsModal.highQualityPenHelp: Allows pen projects to render at higher resolutions and disables some coordinate rounding in the editor. Not all projects benefit from this setting and it may impact performance.
tw.settingsModal.interpolationHelp: Makes projects appear smoother by interpolating sprite motion. Interpolation should not be used on 3D projects, raytracers, pen projects, and laggy projects as interpolation will make them run slower without making them appear smoother.
tw.settingsModal.removeFencingHelp: Allows sprites to move offscreen, become as large or as small as they want, and makes touching blocks work offscreen.
tw.settingsModal.removeMiscLimitsHelp: Removes sound effect limits and pen size limits.
tw.settingsModal.warpTimerHelp: Makes scripts check if they are stuck in a long or infinite loop and run at a low framerate instead of getting stuck until the loop finishes. This fixes most crashes but has a significant performance impact, so it's only enabled by default in the editor.
tw.settingsModal.caseSensitiveListsHelp: Makes lists case sensitive. This means that 'a' and 'A' are different values. This is not recommended for most projects but can improve speed massively for list heavy projects.
tw.settingsModal.realLayerIndexesHelp: Changes layer indexes to change the position in the render order array without limiting the number of layers to the number of drawables.
mw.settingsModal.squareStageCornersHelp: Removes the rounded corners from the stage.
mw.settingsModal.hideDeleteButtonHelp: Hides the delete button on sprites, costumes, and sounds.
mw.settingsModal.hideExtensionButtonHelp: Hides the add extension button in the bottom-left of the block palette.
mw.settingsModal.hideBackpackHelp: Hides the backpack bar at the bottom of the editor.
mw.settingsModal.showMousePositionHelp: Displays the current mouse x/y position next to the stage controls.
mw.settingsModal.showCloneCounterHelp: Shows the total number of active clones next to the stage controls.
mw.settingsModal.showVolumeSliderHelp: Adds a volume slider next to the green flag controls.
mw.settingsModal.muteCtrlClickHelp: Ctrl+Click (Cmd+Click on macOS) the green flag to mute or unmute the project.
mw.settingsModal.stageScreenshotHelp: Adds a camera button to the stage header that copies the stage to the clipboard.
mw.settingsModal.screenshotNotifications: Shows a small preview popup after a stage screenshot is captured.
mw.settingsModal.windowStyleDesktop: Cannot set custom window styling on desktop
tw.settingsModal.fpsHelp: Runs scripts at the selected framerate. Many projects expect 30 FPS and may run too quickly at higher values. Try Interpolation first if you only want smoother motion.
tw.settingsModal.largeStageWarning: Using a custom stage size this large is not recommended! Instead, use a lower size with the same aspect ratio and let fullscreen mode upscale it to match the user's display.
tw.settingsModal.customStageSizeHelp: Changes the size of the Scratch stage from 480x360 to something else. Try 640x360 to make the stage widescreen. Very few projects will handle this properly.
tw.settingsModal.storeProjectOptionsHelp: Saves the runtime options and custom stage size above inside this project. {APP_NAME} applies them whenever the project opens. Warp timer and compiler settings stay local to this device.
mw.settingsModal.storeThemeInProjectHelp: Also save the current theme when you click "Store settings in project." Anyone who opens the project in MistWarp will see that theme.
mw.settings.vc.authorNameHelp: Used as the commit author and as your username when pushing to private repositories.
mw.settings.vc.authorEmailHelp: Recorded as the email address on each commit you make.
mw.settings.vc.defaultBranchHelp: Branch created when a new repository is initialized.
mw.settings.vc.autoCommit: Commit automatically when the project is saved
mw.settings.vc.autoCommitHelp: Creates a commit each time you save the project so your history stays up to date without manual commits.
mw.settings.autosave.enabledHelp: Periodically push the current worktree to MistWarp without creating a version. Edits stay as uncommitted changes.
mw.settings.autosave.intervalHelp: How often autosave pushes, from 1 to 60 minutes.
mw.settings.autosave.notificationsHelp: Show a toast when autosave pushes or fails.
mw.settings.autosave.onlyWhenChangedHelp: Skip the push when nothing changed since the last save.
mw.settingsModal.desktop.updateCheckerHe: Controls which app updates you are notified about. Security updates only shows the most important releases; Never disables the update check entirely.
mw.settingsModal.desktop.microphoneHelp: The input device projects use to record audio, such as the microphone extension.
mw.settingsModal.desktop.cameraHelp: The camera projects use for video sensing.
mw.settingsModal.desktop.hardwareAcceler: Uses the GPU to speed up rendering. Turn this off if you see graphical glitches or crashes on your system.
mw.settingsModal.desktop.backgroundThrot: Pause when the window is not visible
Slows down projects while the window is hidden or minimized to save power. Disable this if projects need to keep running in the background.
mw.settingsModal.desktop.bypassCORS: Allow projects to access any website (requires restart, dangerous)
mw.settingsModal.desktop.bypassCORSHelp: Lets projects fetch data from websites that would normally block them. Only enable this for projects you trust, as it removes a security protection.
mw.settingsModal.desktop.spellcheckerHel: Underlines misspelled words in text fields like the ask block prompt and costume names.
mw.settingsModal.desktop.exitFullscreenO: Exit fullscreen when escape is pressed
Lets the Escape key leave fullscreen mode. Disable this if your project uses Escape for its own controls.
mw.settingsModal.desktop.richPresenceHel: Shows that you are using MistWarp on your Discord profile while the app is open.
